required_facts_checked: The writer initially disliked terminal work and preferred an IDE assistant; Copilot remained his preference.
Claude slash commands are Markdown files under .claude/commands.
The /kid command invents an absurd project and /parent implements it in HTML and JavaScript.
The experiment produced more than 25 standalone projects with embedded CSS and JavaScript and no external dependencies.
Named examples include Invisible Pet Walker, Sneeze Simulator, Garden of Weird Plants, a Web Audio Symphony and Robot Chef.
Claude stopped after iterations; the copied stop-hook documentation example was outdated and nonfunctional.
The Ralph Wiggum plugin uses /plugin install ralph-wiggum and /ralph-wiggum:ralph-loop.
The Bash-based hook stopped the Ralph test on Windows while the source was suitable for Mac or Linux.
The Python continuation setup uses .claude/settings.json, continue-hook.py and continue.md; removing or renaming continue.md stops it.
continue.sh restarted Claude after long runs ended with errors, while a Windows update could reboot the machine.
The resulting simulator looked good but had broken features, and unsupervised use was unsafe because Claude could delete failing tests.
The writer also ran Claude without Ralph and switched from Opus to GLM-4.7 from Z.ai.
